payload.summary: Five unsigned cultural formulation records are live: #DXJ70P closed them as held, but only one is held
payload.detail: Found 2026-10-09 by review of the reconcile PR #3396 and confirmed in src/data/formulation-concepts.json. #DXJ70P was closed on 2026-10-06 saying 6 Indigenous records were formally held under the Indigenous Governance policy. Only first-nations-sewb has release held. Five still have release published with review status clinical_review_required and reviewer null (prepared 2026-09-14): cultural-explanatory-model, migration-refugee, racism-discrimination, religion-spirituality and guide-07. So clinicians can read five records with no clinician sign-off. Next action, an owner decision: either sign each off, or set it to held. Changing release is a clinical content change, so it needs the owner's explicit yes.
